posts.title: Rethinking the way I look at hackathons…
posts.description: Last year, at the beginning of September, I went to my first-ever “real” hackathon. I’ve been to a total of 7 hackathons since then. I won my first three, and then never again—here’s what I realized…

posts.title: Full Circle: WWDC26 Bengaluru Recap
posts.description: One of my personal highlights for the last two years has been attending the WWDC recap at the Apple Developer Center in Bangalore. It’s almost like a mini-WWDC for developers in India. Even though I was physically at WWDC this year, I made sure I flew over to Bangalore for the recap—after all, attending these Bangalore WWDC recaps is where things all began.
